title: A novel windmill-type DyIII [2 × 2] grid exhibiting slow magnetic relaxation

synthesis.procedure: A suspension of Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.1 mmol, 88.48 mg) and H4L (0.2 mmol, 53.02 mg) in MeOH/CH2Cl2 (5 mL/15 mL) was treated with Et3N (0.5 mmol, 0.07 mL). The orange solution was stirred for 6 h, filtered, and the filtrate was left for slow evaporation. Orange block crystals of [Dy4(HL3−)4(MeOH)4]2·7CH2Cl2·MeOH formed after 3 days. Yield: 38 mg (55%, based on the metal salt). The ligand H4L, N′,N″-(butane-2,3-diylidene)bis(2-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzohydrazide), was prepared separately by refluxing two equivalents of 2-hydroxy-3-methoxybenzoic acid hydrazide with one equivalent of butane-2,3-dione in methanol, then filtering and washing the white precipitate with methanol (60%).
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The orange solution was filtered and the filtrate left undisturbed; orange block-shaped crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction formed after 3 days.
synthesis.yield: 38 mg (55%, based on the metal salt)

properties.summary: χMT decreases on cooling from a room-temperature value consistent with four uncoupled Dy(III) ions, with possible weak antiferromagnetic interactions and increasing anisotropy. Under zero dc field, slow relaxation is weak and fast QTM is present; a 900 Oe dc field produces frequency-dependent χ″ peaks characteristic of SMM behaviour, with thermally activated relaxation above 4 K that crosses over toward a direct process at lower temperature.
